theorems.name: Submission.regular_set_lower_lipschitz_cover
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → Ambient n ℓ), Continuous f → ∃ T : ℕ → Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)), {w | DifferentiableAt ℝ f w ∧ Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ f w)} ⊆ ⋃ p, T p ∧ ∀ p, MeasurableSet (T p) ∧ Bornology.IsBounded (T p) ∧ (∀ w ∈ T p, DifferentiableAt ℝ f w ∧ Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ f w)) ∧ ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ v ∈ T p, ∀ w ∈ T p, c * ‖v - w‖ ≤ ‖f v - f w‖
